catalog.download: MCD accepts only the configured MCC HTTPS origin and the canonical scenario artifact route; it fetches only missing or corrupt required bytes.
catalog.integrity: MCD verifies package size and SHA-256 before activation and verifies the complete runtime manifest digest.
catalog.activation: All required objects are staged first; the runtime directory is replaced atomically; a failed sync leaves the active runtime unchanged.
catalog.cache: An exact active manifest and matching package bytes are reused without GET or HEAD requests.

execution.source_of_parameters: MCD observed instance UID/root/version/install type and host applicability facts; scenario policy and upgrade steps remain in the selected artifact.
execution.post_steps: The scenario owns its required cache clear and verification; MCD performs the existing patch resolver/staging and post-source-install patch operation when MCC is reachable, then inventory rescan.

offline: If MCC is unavailable, MCD uses the last verified local runtime scenario. A missing or corrupt required object fails closed.

receipt.upgrade: Existing MCD upgrade operation receipt bound to instance_uid, scenario revision/digest, patch result, final version and inventory rescan.
